title: StriderZ
description: Makes striders zombify in the Overworld like piglins and hoglins do. Now updated to version 26.1.
body:
This pack gives the strider an undead skin when it's in the Overworld. Just like how piglins and hoglins zombify in the Overworld, striders now do that as well (Though you might need to reload the chunks that the strider is in before the undead skin appears). This pack requires Optifine or Entity Texture Features, or else nothing changes. The behavior of the strider is unaffected.

Feel free to rearrange, delete, or modify the files in this pack however you want, as long as you don't release them publicly alongside my files

This pack is natively compatible with Fresh Animations.
